node_definition.done_when: Implement rules 3 and 4 of the block headed Retention, authorised by the lead on 2026-10-01 in section 8 of docs/plans/serving-record-warehouse.html, with its list headed Readings settled after the read-back, as a new module imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_retention.py and an imas-ambix agent retire-raw command in cli.py. By default it lists and writes a manifest; --apply MANIFEST deletes. A raw file is named like deepseek-v4-1-flash-1278105.jsonl: the profile slug, a hyphen, then the SLURM job id. Its compacted siblings are the same stem with .minute.jsonl and .hour.jsonl. A raw file is eligible only when all of these hold: the job id appears in no squeue state for the account (an injected function in tests); the raw file was not modified in the last 24 h; its last parseable row is more than --older-than-days (default 14) days old; and both compacted siblings exist and, for every UTC hour the job spans and for each of generation_tokens, prompt_tokens and uncached_prompt_tokens, the partitioned totals from raw, minute and hour are exactly equal, using telemetry_store's partitioned total. The listing prints per file the job, last row time, size, three totals per counter and pass or fail. It writes a manifest JSON of eligible files only (path, size, sha256, last row time, plus the sha256 of each compacted sibling) under ~/.local/state/ambix/retention/ and prints that manifest's path. --apply re-checks each listed file is still not running, still old enough, and that its sha256 and its siblings' sha256s are unchanged; it then deletes it, printing each removed path, and skips and prints any file that fails a re-check. It never deletes a minute or hour file, a requests receipt, or anything outside the manifest. Tests in tests/test_telemetry_retention.py over a tmp_path fixture assert: a running job's file is listed ineligible; an ended 20-day-old job whose check passes is eligible; an ended 20-day-old job whose minute file is altered in one hour window for one counter is ineligible; a 5-day-old ended job is ineligible; apply deletes only the eligible raw file; a file whose bytes change after listing is skipped by apply; no compacted file is ever removed. The worker never runs the command against /work/projects/imas_gpu/agents/receipts in either mode. Gate: uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_telemetry_retention.py tests/test_telemetry_compaction_runs.py tests/test_agent_ingest_cli.py passes, pytest tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py -k agent_package_modules_parse_with_serving_python passes, uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ambix tests exits 0; the gate log's first line names the commit it ran at and each command's exit status is recorded as EXIT=0 or the non-zero status; any evidence fragment written ends with a trailing newline
